notes.title: Update v1.24 - Wyrm Season
notes.notes:
[h2]- IT'S WYRM SEASON -[/h2]
Join this new Special Event while we celebrate Savant - Ascent REMIX's one year anniversary! 

Jump into Survival from the main menu, and select 'Special' to join. BEWARE - Chaos Waves are back for this event, and this time the dreaded Red Wyrms have joined the party! You can also unlock a unique piece of the soundtrack by defeating Chaos Chesters!

The Competition ends on Monday the 30th - and the winner is rewarded a free code to our upcoming title - Vikings On Trampolines, which soundtrack is composed by none other than Savant himself!

For tips and tricks - don't hesitate to join our Discord! That's where all the pro's are at:

[url=discord.gg/dpadstudio][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876060/794494b53180df4ea12f6f84a02cc2b348fc4052.png[/img][/url]

Here are some additional features and changes in v1.24:

[h3]Auto-Aim Rework:[/h3] In preparing for the game's console release, we've done a massive overhaul of the auto-aiming system. When using a gamepad, you'll now see a crosshair that marks the currently targeted enemy.

For those that struggle with using dual-sticks, the game will now auto target the closest enemy whenever you shoot using the Right Trigger. Pro players will prefer to use the thumbstick to aim, for precise shots!
We are still putting finihsing touches on this feature, so please let us know if you've got any feedback.

We'll have more news on the console launch in the coming weeks.

[h3]Other Minor additions:[/h3]
- Larger fonts for better readabilty on Steam Deck.
- Rankings are now displayed on the leaderboard.
- The Valchemist will no longer evade regular shots.
- In Story Mode, the Valchemist now shoot fireballs instead of his Black Hole attack.
- Minor adjustments to a selection of waves in Survival Mode.
- You must now hold the 'Clear Save' button to delete your save file.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876060/1c25b19d64f73c69e8e20fa0c8f5fcc2bcfc8cb2.png[/img]

notes.title: Update v1.22 - Champion Of Chaos
notes.notes:
[b]Who will become Champion Of Chaos!?[/b]

Starting today, we invite you to join this new Special Event! It's a fierce competition on in Survival Mode, running from 23rd May to 1st of June - 11am PST (Saturday).
Here's what to expect:


[h3][u][b]Chaos Clusters[/b][/u][/h3]
Chaos Cluster are an additional cluster of enemies that appear during a wave. They appear every 5 seconds, and consist of random enemies from the game. Some of these carry useful spells! Destroy these clusters for additional points, and be careful not to let them trample you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876060/6d55b0a685acb379634ccc019d16b4b398d244ff.png[/img]

[h3][u][b]Special Chester[/b][/u][/h3]
A new type of Chester has been added to the game! These carry limited edition Plate Pieces, and are only available during the Special Event.  Plate Pieces dropped from these Chesters are green, and unlocks hidden soundtracks in your Playlist. Catch them while the event is still ongoing!

BUT they won't go down easy! They'll circle you and pelt spells of their own. Use your unlocked abilities to your advantage, and take em down as fast as you can! They'll dissapear before the current wave ends.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876060/8dcde0b684c0ac871b1d79f22df2c0fe035fc3e3.png[/img]

[h3][u][b]Trading Cards[/b][/u][/h3]
Thanks to the game's growing community, Steam has allowed us to add Trading Cards to the game! Earn them from playing Savant - Ascent REMIX, turn them into badges and unique emotes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876060/40282435d9b0180ec03d4407723d64b900a08eb4.png[/img]

Survival Mode is one of the hardest modes of the game, and if you are seeking tips/tricks, head on over to our [url=discord.gg/dpadstudio]Discord[/url], where current champs are eager to give you some pointers!

[url=discord.gg/dpadstudio][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876060/794494b53180df4ea12f6f84a02cc2b348fc4052.png[/img][/url]

v1.22d: Buffed REMIX character - can now perform Ultra Shot without needing to Power LVL. Increased number of missiles on Power Shot: A single charge will fire 3 shots, two charges will fire 5 shots, max charges will fire 7 shots.

notes.title: ULTIMATE UPDATE - Now Live!
notes.notes:
[h1]Classic Mode:[/h1]
A new (or rather Classic) way to experience the game!

[u]New Powers[/u]
This mode lets you unlock new abilities as you ascend through the tower! Some of these abilites are amazingly powerful, like the Spell Book, which lets you absorb projectiles from enemies and store them as spells, which you can cast at any time!

Ultra Shot is another ability - letting you summon a dragon to trash your foes! This is made even more powerful by increasing your Power LVL!

Check out the official trailer below:

[previewyoutube=whlpydStXX4;full][/previewyoutube]

Discover all the new abilities by playing through the Classic Story Mode. These abilities also carry over to Classic Survival Mode & the new Time Attack Mode!

[h3]REMIX Mode:[/h3]
   There's been a slew of changes to this mode as well. Some of the new abilites from Classic Mode are now available, and will be unlocked from the moment you start, including Spin Dash & Ultra Shot.

[h3]Survival Mode:[/h3]
   More challenges has been added, and new waves of enemies to keep you on your toes! Once you complete the FINAL WAVE - a greater challenge awaits - the Samurai is not only joined by foes from the lower levels, but other bosses as well! 

    Look out for wild Chesters, which will start appearing during this phase, carrying CD-pieces to unlock the final songs of the game's soundtrack!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876060/49738c86fc3250e107cc5854c5c8183450046cd8.png[/img]

[h3]Major Addititions:[/h3]
	[u]Reclaim Combo:[/u] If you lose your HIT Combo in REMIX Mode, you can quickly recover it by defeating enemies. Keep your Combo going to earn [u]Power LVLs[/u] which empower your abilities! 

    In Classic Mode, once you find a way to unlock the 'Philosophers Stone' you'll be able to increase your Power LVL by absorbing enemies. When you reach MAX LVL, the Alchemist will break into dance - which charges yet another move - the Spectral Burst!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876060/c3e012b32de937d22ff10d338be9bb5fef83610c.png[/img]

	[u]VSYNC[/u] essentially unlocks the framerate to that of your monitor. If you experience screen tearing while playing, try turning this setting on/off and look for an improvement. Find this new setting in the Main Menu, on the Display Settings page.

    [u]Custom Playlist & Songs[/u] let's you add you fave songs into the game. Drop your .mp3 files in the 'MP3' folder, and your custom songs should will be displayed toward the bottom of the Playlist on the pause menu. This folder is located in the game's installation folder, typically found through your Steam Library.

    [u]Trading Cards & Badges[/u] Thanks to our growing community, Steam has now granted us permission to add Trading Cards for Savant - Ascent REMIX! We'll be adding these shortly - so keep a look out for another update in the near future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876060/0edb2c67fdda9266638c80e605836f97176d6fb9.png[/img]

[i][b]Minor Additions:[/b][/i]
[list]
[*]Menu now display icons to help you navigate them, even if you accidentally toggled to a foreign language.
[*]Screenshake can now be enabled/disabled in Display settings.
[*]12 new Achievements for excelling through the new Classic Mode and Survival.
[*]Volume of logo intros now properly affected by music volume setting.
[/list]

Next up is the Owlboy DLC! Keep an eye out for news on that soon. OH, and if you haven’t yet, please consider leaving a review (wether negative or positive). It helps us small timers immensly to improve future our future games :-)

HOTFIX:
+ 'Dance Off' achievement now unlockable.
+ Power LVL slightly reduced Ultra Charge rate.
+ Samurai's Laser should properly fire in Survival Mode. 

D-Pad (& Savant)!

notes.title: Classic Mode enters BETA!
notes.notes:
Classic Mode is (almost) here! New abilities, play modes and greatly expanded stages await!

Want a sneak-peek right away? You can now opt into the Beta by selecting Savant - Ascent REMIX in your Steam Library, and enter 'Properties'. From here, go to the Betas pane, and select 'Beta' from the dropdown menu. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876060/1a4de45be59d9643f7022a31e6a6141a76f94b53.png[/img]
Once the game has updated - you can now play the latest version of the game, which includes the anticipated 'Classic Mode'.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876060/0b89c1544db54ea5c18995fef892333cef4c0950.png[/img]
[h3]What is Classic Mode?[/h3]
It's essentially an expanded version of the game! Unlockable Power-Ups from the original Savant - Ascent are back (with a vengence) - and you can now play Survival [i]or[/i] the brand new [b]Time Attack Mode[/b] with your unlocked abilities!

Survival Mode has also recieved additional challenges and waves - designed to keep you on your toes even with new powers at your disposal. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876060/8ad8524504396d8d9dfc8da41307fee4801589e3.png[/img]
Time Attack Mode can be played on each stage or as a complete run through the entire game. This weekend, we're doing this year's very first Time Attack [i]Competition[/i], so get your practice in while you can!

[h3]What's Next[/h3]
We still need to finalize in-game texts and translations before official launch, and iron out all the issues that might arise during testing. Want to help us translate the game into your language, or connect with other players? Join our [url=discord.gg/dpadstudio]Discord[/url], as we prepare for the official launch of the Savant - Ascent REMIX Classic Mode!

[url=discord.gg/dpadstudio][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876060/794494b53180df4ea12f6f84a02cc2b348fc4052.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Update v1.15 - Merry Xmas
notes.notes:
Santa's here (in a Vario suit) - and he brings gifts!

Meet him in the Survival Mode during the holiday season!

[h3][u]HIT COMBOs Update[/u][/h3]

HIT Combos now persist through scene transitions, so you can keep your combo going throughout the Story Mode. Keep pelting you attacks at bosses or enemeis to keep your combo going - if you get hit by any of their attacks, your combo is GONE! 

If you Combo is about to dissapear, get some air-time going for a final chance to refresh your combo!

Changelist:
+ 6 new christmas themed challenge encounters in Survival Mode.
+ Combos now stay for an additional second, for a total of 3.5 seconds until it is reset.
+ Big enemies now have visual Health Bars.
+ Final score screen now tallies your Highest HIT Combo and gives you a bonus (100 x Max Hit Combo).
+ Final score screen now awards Boss HIT Bonus, awarding extra points based on your HIT combo as you defeat a boss (100 x Hit Combo).
+ Three new Power Levels.

notes.title: Update v1.14 - Survival Mode PART V
notes.notes:
With [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2279330/view/3753244909556614837]Classic Mode[/url] right around the corner, we're ramping up to it's release with a few additions to Survival Mode + some tweaks to the game.

Oh, and look out for the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2279330/view/3789276275306769985?l=english]Owlboy DLC[/url] hitting Steam on Dec 5th!

In October we hosted a creative competition, and we've started adding challenges suggested by fans on our [url=discord.gg/dpadstudio]Discord[/url]!

[h3]New Survival Challenges:[/h3]
+ Scrap Rush
+ Wyrming Up (I, II and III)
+ Saturn Night

[h3]Minor Changes:[/h3]
+ All big enemies (Voven, Chain-A-Rang, Flailer, Scarecrow) now explode smaller enemies around them.
+ Shark Attack in Survival Mode HP dropped from 200 to 150*.
+ Creeping Goats now level up when a boss is defeated, instead of when their wave end.
+ Reduced speed and HP of Creeping Goats.
+ Asteroids removed from Survival (for now).
+ Increased Bombs HP from 3 to 7 during Samurai Fight.

[h3]Glitch Fixes:[/h3]
+ Fixed bug where Vario would hurt player even while invisible.
+ Fixed Chain-Saw collision detection.
+ Fixed issue with explosions doubling HIT Combo.
+ Fixed issue where Goat enemy could not be defeated*.
+ Fixed crash when trying to shoot Shark Ship in background*.
+ Fixed misspelling of Ceaseless Copters.

*Hotfix for 1.14b

Because some of these fixes address the scoring system - we've created new leaderboards for Story Mode, and made the current leaderboards 'Legacy'. 

They'll remain on the Steam Community for all to see, but you'll no longer be able to compete on these.

notes.title: Update v1.13 - Survival Mode 2.0 + More Spookyness!
notes.notes:
It's our final spooky update! Survival Mode is getting a significant change with this patch! Details below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876060/5cd336c73ec3f344654fb52baadf4859ee782c7e.jpg[/img]

+ New All-Time, Daily & Weekly Survival leaderboards has been added.

This should make the mode less grindy, but still present you with a great challenge as you'll need to change up your strategy with each attempt to increase your standing on the leaderboard!

notes.title: Patch 1.09 - Chainsaws & Auto-Fire - 9th Oct
notes.notes:
Today's patch seeks to turn an enemy attack against them, and introduces Auto-Fire! Below are a list of changes:

- You can toggle Auto-Fire with the Middle Mouse Button. A prompt in the top-left corner will show up, indicating your toggle. Auto-Fire will charge and shoot your normal missile attacks automaticly. Give your index-finger a rest with this life-saving feature!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876060/dc29e9122dc4254bba6599982a6b88c0066f58bf.png[/img]

- Chain-A-Rang attacks can now be deflected against them.
- Deflecting a Chain-A-Rang's attack grants you a +5 HIT Bonus.
- Deflected Chainsaws can destroy enemies in it's path and rack up points & HITs as if the player defeated the enemy normally.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876060/b2c9184a93ec41a5925607ccbcd0a9057e562d90.png[/img]

By now you might have noticed the Playlist in your Pause Menues. Blast your enemies while you blast some new tracks! Now you'll be able to [b]unlock 5 additional songs[/b] by playing the [b]Hardcore Mode[/b]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876060/6158583b9c57ef82aa09ba99ca272bf6e267a352.png[/img]

Chests that spawn during this mode will contain unique pieces of the soundtrack! BEWARE - [i]dying in Hardcore will set you right back to the first stage[/i] - but trust us - these melodies are worth it! As an additional motivation, [b]each boss now grants you an achievement in Hardcore Mode[/b].

Need tips & tricks on how to beat Hardcore? Watch the masters at play on our [url=http://discord.gg/dpadstudio]Discord[/url] server!

[url=http://discord.gg/dpadstudio][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876060/794494b53180df4ea12f6f84a02cc2b348fc4052.png[/img][/url]

Oh, and last but not least! Keep your eyes peeled next week as we'll reveal more details on the upcoming [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2279330/view/3753244909556614837?l=english]'Classic Mode'[/url]!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2279330/view/3753244909556614837?l=english][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876060/4358e501b978b67fe2241ef870e0f9116eac3ead.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Update v1.06 - Survival Mode Content Part III
notes.notes:
OK folks - while we're working with Classic Mode, we still got some stuff updated for the Survival Mode of the game, together with some other tweaks over-all. Here's a full list:

+ Biomes has been added to Survival Mode, indicating which boss will spawn next. We're going to keep working with biomes to spawn enemy patters that belong to each specific area. You'll enter a new area approx 10 sec before a boss encounter.
+ Leaderboard has been added to the Pause Menu of Survival Mode.
+ Increased max camera radius around player on Survival Mode.
+ Big enemies has had their HIT bonus increased. Chain-A-Rangs now award 5 HITS, while Wyrms, Scarecrows, Vovens and Flailers award 10 HITS.
+ Added quick-keys to play next or previous song. Press period-key to play next, and comma-key to play previous.

Bug fixes:
+ Fixed crash when playlist ran out of songs.

Join our [url=discord.gg/dpadstudio]Discord[/url] to follow development, or check out our Steam Community!

notes.title: Update v1.04 - Oct 1st - Balance Patch
notes.notes:
We want to thank everyone for playing and giving your feedback on Savant - Ascent REMIX! As we're working to add more content to the game, we're also listening to your comments on the game in general.

Today, we have worked on a balance patch to make enemies less bullet-spongy, also addressing one of the more elusive bosses of the game! Read on for a full list of changes:

- Power Shots now stack damage on tougher enemies. Some enemies can now be one shotted with a well-placed & fully charged Power Shot.
- Damage from Power Shots have been reduced for all enemies (as a compensation for multi-hits).
- Reduced Crystal Bat HP from 5 to 3.
- Reduced Scarecrow HP from 55 to 50.
- Reduced Flailer HP from 45 to 40.
- Reduced Swooper HP from 5 to 3.
- Reduced Iron Chopper HP from 5 to 3.
- Reduced Chester HP from 15 to 10.
- Reduced Buzz Saw HP from 10 to 7
- Reduced Chain-a-Rang HP reduced from 20 to 10 (once shield has been disabled) 
- Reduced Voven HP from 75 to 50.
- Reduced Ghost Baby HP from 15 to 10.
- Reduced Ninja Drills HP from 10 to 5

- Valchemist can now be hit by normal projectiles. Watch out for his black-hole attack, it will absorb your missiles and grow larger!
- Increased HIT-combo fade delay from 1.5sec to 2 sec.

We are now working on additional content for the Survival Mode for tomorrow. Check back ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Ten years on, Owlboy developers are remastering their first shoot-em-up
notes.notes:
Owlboy developers D-Pad Studio are swooping back in time to revisit their very first game, Savant - Ascent, originally released ten years ago. Savant - Ascent Anniversary Edition is remastering the shoot-em-up platformer in which you control Savant - avatar of Norwegian music producer Aleksander Vinter - with new stages, bosses, powerups, and a revamped soundtrack by Vinter himself. The remaster will launch on PC and other platforms later this summer.

Read more

notes.title: REMASTER Announced! Savant - Ascent Anniversary Edition!
notes.notes:
HERE WE GO! We couldn’t let Savant - Ascent’s 10 Year Anniversary go uncelebrated! 

Today, we are officially announcing Savant - Ascent Anniversary Edition, a complete remaster of the game! Check out the trailer for yourself and join the final ascent. More details below:

Visit the Steam page: http://bit.ly/savantgame

[previewyoutube=Lw5RvCS53hs;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]New Everything![/h3]

There are some huge upgrades! Not only will the game feature suped up versions of the original bosses, but NEW bosses will put you through some truly intense battles as you ascend!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876060/2e8212f7ad5f1c0ee190332dfec362ad0b4f3dc9.gif[/img]
(Yes, the Laser Sharks gets to try to kick your ass for real this time!)

[h3]Welcome One and All![/h3]

We want to teach new players how to properly play, while upping the challenge for experienced ones! New to Ascent? This is the version for you! Mastered the original version? Well, just you wait!

There are new abilities & moves to master, like the double-jump & backflip! Accidentally jumped into a batch of baddies? Nope outta there! You can also do Power Shots mid air!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876060/918eb72f2186a2a10524ce8c4ef717b683806834.gif[/img]

[h3]The Music![/h3]

Oh, and the best news!? Savant has officially joined D-Pad Studio as our lead sound designer and composer. He has created an ENTIRE new soundtrack for the game! He'll be dropping songs & teasers from the OST, so follow him on Instagram or Twitter for some juicy tunes: Savant ([url=https://twitter.com/SavantOfficial]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/savantofficial/]Instagram[/url])

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876060/2e8212f7ad5f1c0ee190332dfec362ad0b4f3dc9.gif[/img]

[h3]More To Come[/h3]
Over the coming weeks, we’ll be sharing more from the game - so Wishlist the Anniversary Edition on Steam, and join us in celebrating 10 years of Savant - Ascent: http://bit.ly/savantgame.
